title: Siegard subagent frontmatter
description: Frontmatter contract for a distributable subagent under src/claude/agents/. Every constraint is either taken from Anthropic documentation, cited per field, or a named Siegard addition. Source, retrieved 2026-07-29: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents (field inventory, requiredness, and enums). The markdown body becomes the subagent's system prompt. Decision and divergence list: docs/adr/0009-component-contracts-from-anthropic-documentation.md. additionalProperties is false because Claude Code silently ignores unknown frontmatter fields — a typo like 'tool:' would otherwise ship an agent that inherits every tool.

name.description: Unique identifier, documented as 'lowercase letters and hyphens'; names cannot contain ':', which is reserved for plugin-scoped identifiers. Identity comes only from this field. Siegard addition: the validator requires the filename stem to equal it — the harness permits a mismatch, but a file whose name is not the agent's name breaks path-based traceability.

description.description: When Claude should delegate to this subagent. This is the delegation trigger: state the role and the situations that warrant it, in third person.

tools.description: Tools the subagent can use, as a comma-separated string or a list. SIEGARD DIVERGENCE, deliberate: the harness makes this optional and an omitted field inherits every tool available to subagents. Under CLAUDE.md's Security invariants the absence of a statement is not a grant, so a distributable agent must enumerate its grant. An agent that genuinely needs everything must say so explicitly, and defend it at review.

disallowedTools.description: Tools to deny, removed from the resolved list. Applied before tools is resolved; a tool listed in both is removed.

model.description: Model for the subagent: an alias, a full model ID, or 'inherit'. Defaults to inherit.

permissionMode.description: How the subagent handles permission prompts. SIEGARD DIVERGENCE, deliberate: the harness also documents 'bypassPermissions', and this contract excludes it — a distributed component that skips every permission prompt grants itself what no contract enumerated, in a repository Siegard does not control. A downstream repository that wants it must add it locally, outside the distribution.

maxTurns.description: Maximum number of agentic turns before the subagent stops.

skills.description: Skills whose full content is preloaded into the subagent's context at startup. Skills with disable-model-invocation: true cannot be preloaded.

mcpServers.description: MCP servers available to this subagent: a string references an already-configured server, an object is an inline definition keyed by server name. Inline entries follow the .mcp.json server schema, which is governed by https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp, not by this contract.

hooks.description: Lifecycle hooks scoped to this subagent, such as a PreToolUse validator. The hook configuration format is governed by https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks, not by this contract.

memory.description: Persistent memory scope. 'project' stores under .claude/agent-memory/<name>/ and is the documented recommended default; 'local' is the same but untracked; 'user' is machine-wide.

background.description: true always runs this subagent as a background task. When unset, Claude chooses. Background subagents run with a reduced built-in tool set — verify the tools grant survives that filter.

effort.description: Effort level for the subagent. Default: inherits from the session; available levels depend on the model.

isolation.description: Runs the subagent in a temporary git worktree with an isolated copy of the repository; auto-removed if unchanged.

color.description: Display color in the task list and transcript.

initialPrompt.description: Auto-submitted as the first user turn when this agent runs as the main session agent via --agent or the agent setting.
